home.heroSubtitle: Digital HR & Employee Information Management System
home.heroDescription: A secure, modern, multilingual platform for Ambo University and Ethiopian Federal Government employees. Streamlining employee life history registration, pension documentation, attendance tracking, and leave administration.
home.whyChooseSubtitle: Engineered for compliance, efficiency, and federal employee service excellence.
home.featureEasyDesc: Clean interface designed for clarity. Complete your official documentation in minutes on any device.
home.featureSecureDesc: Strict role-based access control and encrypted data storage protecting sensitive personal records.
home.featureTrilingualDesc: Native fluency in English, Afaan Oromoo, and Amharic with immediate seamless switching.
home.featureFastDesc: Instant form dispatch directly to administrative review queues with real-time status tracking.
home.featureAutoSaveDesc: Automatic client-side draft recovery so employees never lose their in-progress documentation.
home.featureValidationDesc: Built-in validation checks ensure mandatory federal civil service fields are accurately captured.
home.formSectionsSubtitle: Official federal documentation workflows streamlined into digital self-service.
home.service1Desc: Official Ethiopian civil service identification, birth documentation, nationality, and residence history.
home.service2Desc: Marital status, dependent children, and nominated emergency contacts for institutional records.
home.service3Desc: Complete educational history from primary, secondary, college, and university accreditation.
home.service4Desc: Comprehensive history of prior governmental offices, positions held, and service tenures.
home.service5Desc: Public Servants Social Security Agency (PSSSA) pension registration and service computation.
home.service6Desc: Multi-tier proficiency evaluation across reading, writing, speaking, and listening capabilities.
home.contactSubtitle: Get in touch with the Ambo University Human Resources Directorate.
home.contactAddressDesc: Ambo University, Woliso Business and Economics Campus, Woliso, Ethiopia
home.contactMessagePlaceholder: How can our HR Directorate assist you?
home.contactSuccessMsg: Thank you! Your inquiry has been routed to the Ambo University HR Directorate.
home.footerDescription: Official digital human resource and public servant documentation portal for Ambo University.
home.footerLegal: Ambo University HRMS. All rights reserved.
